name: Halo: Reach (MCC)

scale.why: speeds measured in Forge metres; scaled to 1.8 m taking the Spartan as about 7 ft (2.134 m, the H2EK player reference): 0.8435 m per Forge metre

speed.note: one player's measurement over the Forge grid; the 1.8 m rescale is an assumption

gravity.source: https://www.bungie.net/en/Forums/Post/3291870 (jump peak 195 % of the Spartan's height, 1.2 s in the air)
gravity.note: derived from the measured jump: rise = (195 - 100) % of 1.8 m = 1.71 m, g = 8 x rise / airtime^2

jump.note: take-off speed = 4 x rise / airtime = 4 x 1.71 / 1.2

dash.note: no dash in the default loadouts (Reach's Evade armour ability is a dodge)

grapple.note: no grapple (Halo Infinite adds the Grappleshot)

jumpHeight.note: 95 % of the player's height, scaled to 1.8 m; Quark: 1.22 m

tagRunSpeed.source: https://github.com/Sopitive/HaloMapStudio/blob/main/crates/hms-app/src/film_anim.rs#L133 (Spartan run forward 2.200 wu/s, read from matg @player information)
tagRunSpeed.note: 2.2 wu/s x 3.048 m/wu, rescaled like the rest of this file: within 2% of the bungie.net measurement (the speed value above)

tagJumpApex.source: https://github.com/Sopitive/HaloMapStudio/blob/main/crates/hms-app/src/play_phys.rs#L425-446 (jump velocity 2.300 wu/s, gravity 4.1712594 wu/s2 from the engine's physics constants)
tagJumpApex.note: v^2/2g = 0.634 wu, rescaled: within 5% of the measured jump height above; the tool notes the biped's integration isn't verified

extras: armour abilities: sprint, evade (a dodge), jetpack, armour lock
slow, high jumps compared with arena shooters: the airtime (1.2 s) is about twice Quark's
notes: One player's measurements (bungie.net, 2011): run speed over the Forge grid, jump height in hundredths of the Spartan's height and airtime. Gravity and jump speed are derived from the height and airtime (estimates), and everything is rescaled to a 1.8 m player taking the Spartan as 7 ft.

sources.title: bungie.net: classic Halo movement speed, jump height, gravity
H2EK: Player Statistics and Metrics (Spartan about 7 ft)
